CustomField.description: When enabled, a confirmation email is sent as a submission is received, through the Form_Submission_Convert_Utility_Send_Email_Overridable flow. The template is resolved from Email Template Name (Confirmation) (or a Form Template Source override) and the recipients from Recipients (Confirmation Email).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When enabled, a confirmation email is sent automatically as soon as a new submission is received. Choose the recipients in Recipients (Confirmation Email) and set the template in the Email Templates component on this page; leave it off if no email should be sent.
CustomField.label: Send Confirmation Email
